title: Nacho Libre
about: A monastery cook in Mexico secretly moonlights as a luchador to buy better food for the orphans.
cue: Serve the mains when Nacho spends his wrestling pay on the orphans.

    StartersEsqueleto's corn chipsFried corn tortilla wedges with lime zest and chilli, fresh tomato salsaHow to make it12 corn tortillas500ml vegetable oil, for frying1 tsp salt1 lime, zested and juiced1 tsp chilli powder4 tomatoes, diced1/2 white onion, dicedCut the tortillas into wedges and fry in the vegetable oil at 180°C until crisp.Toss in salt, lime zest and chilli powder.Mix the tomatoes and onion with lime juice and salt.Serve the chips warm with the salsa.Elote, get that corn outta my faceCharred corn with lime mayo, feta, chilli powder and corianderHow to make it4 corn cobs4 tbsp mayonnaise1 lime, juiced80g feta, crumbled1 tsp chilli powder1 tbsp coriander, chopped2 limes, cut in wedgesGrill the corn over high heat until charred all over.Mix the mayonnaise with lime juice and brush on.Roll in feta.Sprinkle with chilli powder and coriander.Serve hot with lime wedges.MainsNacho's chorizo and potato tacosCrispy chorizo and potato in corn tortillas with avocado and pickled onionHow to make it2 chorizos, diced400g potatoes, diced1 white onion, sliced, for the filling1 pinch of chilli flakes1 white onion, sliced, for pickling2 limes, juiced12 small corn tortillas2 avocados, sliced1 handful of corianderFry the chorizo, potatoes, onion and chilli until crisp and golden.Quickly pickle the extra onion in lime juice.Warm the tortillas.Spoon the filling into the tortillas with avocado, pickled onion and coriander.Oaxaca chicken mole with sesame riceNot an eagle egg. Those eggs were a lie.How to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs simmered in a mole of dried chillies, tomato, garlic, cinnamon, almonds and dark chocolate blitzed smooth, served with rice and toasted sesame.Toast 4 dried ancho chillies in a dry pan, then soak in 500ml hot chicken stock for 20 minutes.Fry a chopped onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tomatoes, 50g almonds, 1 tsp cinnamon and the chillies with their stock, and blitz smooth with 40g dark chocolate.Brown 1kg chicken thighs, pour over the mole and simmer covered for 40 minutes.Serve over steamed rice with toasted sesame seeds.SweetsCinnamon churros with chocolate dipFried dough sticks rolled in cinnamon sugar with a chocolate dipping sauceHow to make it250ml water60g butter1 pinch of salt150g plain flour2 eggs1 L vegetable oil, for frying100g caster sugar2 tsp ground cinnamon150g dark chocolate100ml thickened creamBoil the water, butter and salt, then beat in the flour until it leaves the sides of the pan.Cool, then beat in the eggs one at a time.Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into 180°C oil and fry until golden.Roll in the sugar and cinnamon.Melt the chocolate with the cream and serve warm for dipping.DrinksHorchata, cinnamon rice drinkChilled sweet rice and cinnamon milk poured over iceHow to make it200g long grain rice2 cinnamon sticks1 L water100g caster sugar250ml milk2 cups ice1 pinch of ground cinnamonSoak the rice and cinnamon sticks in the water overnight.Blend until smooth and strain through a fine cloth.Stir in the sugar and milk until dissolved.Chill well, pour over ice and dust with cinnamon.
